output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow where 'mintedAmount' is added to 'totalSupply', aka 'tradeTrap' issue.
The buy function has an integer overflow where 'amount' is calculated by 'msg.value * buyRate', aka 'tradeTrap' issue.
The transferFrom function allows a user to transfer more tokens than allowed, due to incorrect comparison of 'allowance[_from][msg.sender]' and '_value'.
The transfer function allows a user to transfer more tokens than allowed, due to incorrect comparison of 'balanceOf[_to] + _value < balanceOf[_to]'.
The withdrawToOwner function allows a potential attacker to withdraw any ERC20 token due to lack of access control.
